review: 408.2-1: the loyalty-7 variant flipped on whether the loyalty cost could be paid, not on emblem creation; replaced it with a Stifle variant where the -8 is activated and countered, adding Island and Stifle for B.

scenarios.title: An emblem is created in the command zone and persists after its source dies

setup.notes: Elspeth has been under A's control since before this turn and has not activated this turn.

decisions: A activates Elspeth's -8 ability, removing eight loyalty counters.
B passes priority with Stifle unused; the ability resolves and A gets an emblem.
B casts Shock targeting Grizzly Bears, tapping Mountain.

variants.label: base
variants.expected: A's emblem is in the command zone. Elspeth has 0 loyalty and moves to A's graveyard in the state-based check, while the emblem stays in the command zone. Grizzly Bears has 2 damage marked and stays on the battlefield because of the emblem's indestructible.

variants.label: stifled
variants.delta: In response to the -8 ability, B casts Stifle targeting it, tapping Island, and Stifle resolves first.
variants.expected: The -8 ability is countered and no emblem is created; the command zone stays empty. Elspeth has 0 loyalty and moves to A's graveyard in the state-based check. Shock deals 2 damage to Grizzly Bears, which moves to A's graveyard.

operation.unclassifiable: A different spell cast: B casts Stifle on the activated ability, a player decision no fork operation makes.

detector.outcome: A resolution of an Effect-API ability with a permanent duration creates a lasting effect object in the command zone (an emblem), which stays after its source leaves the battlefield.
detector.near_miss: A resolution of the same kind of permanent-duration Effect ability that creates no continuous effect.
